g.text: Full SIFT1M: recall difference at matching k / ef
1,000,000 base vectors · 10,000 queries · maximum absolute difference: 0.1000 percentage points
Historical run: one independent build per variant, 16 physical build cores, one NUMA socket, no interleave.
Recall is identical for 1 and 16 query threads within each variant; positive values favor current HVS. No uncertainty estimate.
